data.one_liner: Provides convenient access to multiline String records with method extensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides method extensions on strings to easily handle multiline templates, mockups, and SQL queries using a pipeline symbol to indicate the beginning of a line. Allows formatting strings with multiline() or splitting them into iterables using multilineSplit().
use_when: You need to format large SQL queries or text templates inside Dart strings cleanly.
You want to strip pipeline symbols and clean up multiline string indentation.
avoid_when: You are working with standard raw strings where custom line-start symbols are not desired.
strengths: Simple method extensions for string manipulation.
Useful for keeping templates and SQL queries readable in code.
weaknesses: Very niche utility that can often be achieved with standard Dart multiline string features.
